name: theology_cpt_sota_qwen35_4b_one_doc_padded
description: After B v12 eval rose at 1e-5: one-doc padded rows (no GDN concat leak), GDN LoRA on padded path. GPU_PROFILE auto (t4 4-bit / ampere bf16 on sm_80+ 4090/L4/A100). Do not C/merge. Does not replace Phase-1 B_training.ipynb.

model.name: unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-Base
model.experiment_9b_note: Concession-gated E3 only; mandatory VRAM probe peak reserved < ~15 GB
model.gpu_profile_note: auto = t4 if sm_75 (4-bit), ampere if sm_80+ (4090/L4/A100 bf16 LoRA ~10GB, load_in_4bit=false). Override with env GPU_PROFILE=t4|ampere.
model.architecture_note: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration hybrid linear_attention+full_attention; vision_config present — verify Unsloth CPT on Kaggle

lora.lm_head_note: M1: tied embeddings on Qwen3.5-4B-Base — train embed_tokens only unless D4 proves otherwise
lora.lora_gdn_note: in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / out_proj on one_doc_padded only. Never in_proj_a / in_proj_b.

optim.packing_note: GatedDeltaNet: native packing silently leaks; isolated concat of two complete short docs still leaks. one_doc_padded = one doc or 2048 window per row. pad_to_max=false (GDN may ignore mask). Do not re-enable native packing.
optim.train_embeddings_note: v7 default True on batch 1×16. Ampere bf16 stays ON with embed LoRA (lm_head dtype-align hook). T4 + embeds stays float32. If Ampere OOMs: drop EVAL_DOCS_PER_BUCKET then TRAIN_EMBEDDINGS=false before dropping GDN.
optim.max_steps_note: After pack, MAX_STEPS is set to ceil(packed_rows/16) (one padded epoch; ~674 on B v13 10779 rows). Initial 476 is a placeholder. Abort-at-50 still applies.
optim.save_only_model: true on Kaggle / false on Runpod
optim.abort_note: TrainerCallback stops if eval_spurgeon_loss at step 50 is strictly worse than step 25. Flat/equal continues. EarlyStopping patience=2 is a second line.

eval.per_bucket_during_training_note: EVAL_BUCKETS_DURING_TRAIN=[spurgeon]; mix val is always unioned if present.
eval.adapter_override: Do not set to B v6 checkpoint-25 (C v4 already scored it). After B v7 leave null to load theology_cpt_lora.

vram_fallbacks: TRAIN_EMBEDDINGS=false only if batch-1 embed LoRA still OOMs (will not hit -15% PPL)
success_criteria: Manifest ≥4 buckets, shares in targets, verified_tokens, holdouts non-empty
Spurgeon holdout better than base (%Δ-vs-own-base after base swap)
General holdout PPL ≤10% worse than base
Heidelberg MCQ ≥ +10 pts vs base; WSC near-ceiling — informational; do not ship on MCQ if holdout PPL fails
Greedy style preferred over base for Spurgeon-ness
